Definition:
Logical model for the Nigeria HIV Tracking Register. One instance represents
one facility monthly tracking page and contains repeatable client entries for
current ART clients who missed a scheduled clinic appointment. The printed
register instructs facilities to enter eligible clients within 24 hours of
default.
Identifier assigned to the monthly HIV Tracking Register page or its electronic equivalent.
Reference to the facility maintaining the tracking register, when available.
State where the facility is located.
Local Government Area where the facility is located.
Official name of the facility maintaining the register.
Month and year in which clients missed their appointments. Each month begins on a new register page.
One patient-level row in the monthly HIV Tracking Register.

Definition: Reference to the corresponding Nigeria Core Patient resource, when available.
Monthly serial number beginning from one for each new register page.
Facility-specific hospital number.
Client unique ART program identifier. The printed register records hospital number and unique ID separated by a forward slash.
Constraint(s): T7 Unique ART ID after slash

Definition: Client full name, including aliases documented in the clinical folder.
Client sex represented by the printed male and female boxes.
Age in completed years at the time of tracking-register entry.
Descriptive address sufficient to support tracing when necessary.
One or more client telephone numbers documented in the folder.
Date the client commenced antiretroviral therapy.
Current ART regimen using the adult or paediatric regimen code printed in the register legend.

Short: T14 Current ART regimen source text
Definition: Regimen description retained when the source does not contain a valid register code.
True when P was appended to the ART regimen code.
True when BF was appended to the ART regimen code.
Devolved, non-devolved or not eligible.
Facility-based or community-based model, recorded with the DSD status and separated by a slash.
Reason the client was entered into the tracking register.
Narrative description when T16 code 11e is used.

Short: T17 Date of last actual contact or appointment
Definition: Date the client last attended or had actual contact with the facility.
Date the client missed the scheduled follow-up appointment.
A tracking attempt made by phone call or home visit. Each stage should occur no more than once per entry.

Definition: Mode used for the attempt.
Guardian, client, treatment partner or not contacted.
Reason the client missed the appointment when successful contact established the cause.
Narrative description when reason-for-defaulting code 11 is selected.
True when the client no longer receives HIV care at the facility.
Date care at the facility was discontinued when T24 is true.
Major reason the client stopped receiving care at the facility.

Short: T27 Next agreed clinic appointment date
Definition: Date the contacted client agreed to return. The SOP states that this should be before 28 days after the missed appointment.
Date the client returned to the facility for any health service.
One or more services to which the returning client was referred.
Total number of client rows on the page. Other printed column totals should be derived from entry data.
Name of the contact-tracking focal person or representative who completed the register.
Designation of the person who completed the register.
Date the register page was completed.
Signature or an electronic signature reference for the person completing the register.
